questions.question: An AI agent receives a user request that requires searching the web and then calculating the total cost. How does an agent typically determine which tool to invoke first?

options.text: It invokes every registered tool in alphabetical order
It always invokes the calculator before interpreting the request
The LLM selects an appropriate tool based on the request, available tool descriptions, and current execution context
The vector database automatically determines the tool execution order

questions.explanation: In an LLM-driven agent, the model reasons about the task and selects an available tool based on its description and the current context. The agent executes the tool, observes its result, and may decide on subsequent actions.

questions.question: A developer observes that an LLM produces inconsistent responses for the same classification task. Which parameter should generally be reduced to make sampling more deterministic?
questions.explanation: Lower temperature generally makes token sampling less random by concentrating probability on higher-probability tokens. However, temperature zero does not guarantee identical outputs across every model, provider, or execution environment.

questions.question: A LangChain application contains a retriever, an LLM call, and a response parser. The team wants to identify exactly which component is causing failures. What is the most effective observability approach?

options.text: Record only the final response generated by the application
Instrument each component with appropriately nested observations and capture relevant inputs, outputs, errors, and timings
Store all errors in a single unstructured text file without execution identifiers
Disable intermediate logging to reduce storage usage

questions.explanation: Component-level tracing provides visibility into each execution stage. With nested observations, developers can identify whether failures originate in retrieval, model generation, or output parsing and inspect the associated errors and timings.
